About POSH Inquiry Navigator

Live online purchases are currently closed.

POSH Inquiry Navigator is a web-based preparation tool from The Cosmic Energizers for Internal Committees and Local Committees. It provides a guided inquiry workflow, editable working drafts and tools to organise procedural records. The Essential, Professional and Advanced plans add different preparation tools and account allowances.

The Committee remains responsible for assessing the facts, applying the governing procedure and approving any findings or recommendations. Navigator provides self-service software. It does not provide representation, file documents, or operate a government portal.
